market_question: Will Kolkata Knight Riders win the 2026 Indian Premier League?
reasoning: KKR are the 2024 champions, retain a strong core, and have systemic advantages. A fair winning chance for a top IPL franchise is ~10–12% per season, far above the implied 2%.
evidence_points: KKR won IPL 2024 and retained key players (Russell, Narine, Rinku Singh, Chakravarthy, Harshit Rana) for the 2025 mega auction cycle.
Franchises of KKR's historical and financial strength typically have at least a 10% chance of winning any IPL edition.
The 2026 season is two years away, but the core squad and management stability reduce downside uncertainty.
sources_consulted: IPL official site for past results
